newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight rates widen in tight market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight rates widen in tight market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound edged higher in a tight market on Monday to between 10 1/8 and 10 1/2 percent from Sunday's range of 10 1/8 and 10 3/8 percent, bankers said.
They said a few private banks were asking for 10 3/4 percent and even some public sector banks, which normally lend at 10 1/2 percent, were asking for about 11 percent.
"It's the beginning of the week and banks are still looking for money to cover their reserve requirements. It's normally short on Sundays and Mondays," a banker said.
One-week rates were unchanged at 10 1/4 and 10 3/8 percent.
